text: Capitol Correspondents Association Agenda, Annual Meeting, 1/18/22, 12:15 pm Welcome Approval of minutes of 2021 annual meeting Financial report President’s report: Respectful workplace. COVID-19 policy in press room. WiFi password (posted in press room). Liaison to leadership if needed. Reminder: Enter Idaho Press Club contest, deadline is this week: www.idahopressclub.org. Officers. Bylaws call for president and standing committee to serve a two-year term. Those up for re-election this year, should they agree to continue to serve, are Melissa Davlin and our vice president, Kevin Richert. Those continuing to serve for another year are President Betsy Russell and standing committee members James Dawson and Joan Cartan-Hansen. Nominations and vote. Media access concerns. Copies of the one-page Guidelines adopted by the Legislative Council are available and posted in the press room and on the Capitol Correspondents website, www.idahopressclub.org/capitol-correspondents-association/; it summarizes existing media access rules. Members are invited to share any questions or concerns about access. House clerks have again taken over one of the two press desks on the floor to allow for their own social distancing this session during the pandemic. Dues. If you haven’t paid online, please do so. Other business, if any Adjournment
